bio.zh: 笛卡尔是法国哲学家、数学家与自然哲学家。他以方法怀疑重新追问知识的基础，论证心灵与身体的区分，也研究二者的统一及激情。他将形而上学、物理学与实践生活相联结，其著作和通信深刻影响了近代思想的形成。
bio.en: René Descartes was a French philosopher, mathematician, and natural philosopher. He used systematic doubt to investigate the foundations of knowledge, defended a distinction between mind and body, and also examined their union and the passions. His work connected metaphysics with the study of nature and practical life, helping to shape the questions of early modern philosophy.

bio.zh: 康德是德国哲学家，长期在柯尼斯堡生活与任教。他通过批判哲学考察经验知识的条件与理性的限度，以自主性说明道德与自由，并在审美和目的论中探索自然与自由的联系。他的三部《批判》持续影响认识论、伦理学与美学。
bio.en: Immanuel Kant was a German philosopher who lived and taught in Königsberg. His critical philosophy examined the conditions of experience and the limits of human knowledge. He placed autonomy at the centre of moral life and explored how judgments of beauty and natural purposes connect nature with freedom. His three Critiques remain central to epistemology, ethics, and aesthetics.

bio.zh: 贝克莱是爱尔兰哲学家，曾任都柏林圣三一学院研究员和克洛因主教。他从感知与观念出发，批评独立于心灵的物质实体，提出以心灵及其观念为核心的非物质主义。他的研究还涉及视觉、自然科学、宗教与社会生活。
bio.en: George Berkeley was an Irish philosopher, a fellow of Trinity College Dublin, and later Bishop of Cloyne. His immaterialism challenged the idea of matter existing independently of minds and explained reality through minds and their ideas. His investigations of perception and knowledge also extended to vision, natural science, religion, and questions of social life.
